# Pre-retention case store fixture

`store.sql` was generated by the application at commit
`e1c1635895e0d946e556e0398d78ef9e2b65525c`, before schema v2 was implemented.
It contains only the existing Alpine synthetic input, one case and three
accepted revisions: creation, a gross-receipts correction and a proposed-rate
edit. UUIDs and recording timestamps were generated by that application.

`provenance.json` pins the original DDL and schema identity, SQL hash, source
commit/tree, original operation UUIDs, ETags and receipt hashes. The original
binary database hash is provenance; reconstructing the SQL into SQLite can
produce different file bytes while preserving every original row and receipt.

Tests reconstruct this fixture into owned temporary files. They check v1
read/write/replay/retry behavior, source preservation, copy upgrades and both
versions of backup/restore. Do not regenerate it with the schema-v2 application.
